notes.content: [p]This update includes:[/p][p]- Summer Time Season event[/p][p]- levels tuning[/p][p]- multiple fixes and improvements[/p]

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
This update includes:
- 75 new levels
- New Fir-streak event
- Christmas Season event
- Advent calendar tasks with huge rewards (available till December 31)
- multiple fixes and improvements.

notes.title: November 15 update and Thanksgiving Season start
notes.content:
This update includes:
- massive rebalancing of all levels for smooth gameplay!
- 50 NEW levels!
- New Thanksgiving event with amazing rewards!

notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.content: This quick update fixes several bugs and improves performance.

notes.title: Spooky update
notes.content:
This major update includes:
- Halloween Rush limited time event with new game mode and huge prizes. 
- Harvest Season event with impressive rewards.
- New gameplay mechanics: bonus combinations.
- Balance improvements for hundreds of levels.

notes.title: Lunar New Year update
notes.content:
This major update includes:
New episode: Lunar Festival!
New location to rebuild!
Dozens of new levels with more to come soon!
Improvements and fixes.

notes.title: Update - December 20, 2023
notes.content:
This update includes:
- New Boosters feature! Start levels with additional bonuses!
- Dozens of rebalanced and improved levels.
- Bugs fixes and small visual improvements.

notes.title: December 6, 2023
notes.content:
This update includes:
- Fixed levels
- Dutch localization
- Special holiday sale!

notes.title: November 2023 major update
New chapter (December 21, 2021 update)
notes.content:
Greetings!
In this version we’ve added a whole new chapter - “Gingerbread Tale”. 
It features a new location, 44 new quests given by Elf, and lots of new amazing levels.
